The '''Battle of Lorell''' took place between the [[Lorell Raiders]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==Prelude==
The [[Lorell Raiders]] were [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and mercenaries who discovered safe passages through the [[Transitory Mists]] of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] around [[4200 BBY]].<ref name="atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Operating from the central planet of [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]], the Lorell Raiders would venture into [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] space to prey upon Republic shipping lanes and take any woman they found beautiful back to Hapes as slaves. This practice went on for many years, until the actions of the Lorell Raiders caught the attention of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="atlas" />

==The battle==
Around [[4030 BBY]], [[Arca Jeth]] was put in charge of a Jedi fleet, and caught the Lorell Raiders by surprise outside the Transitory Mists, destroying most of them.<ref name="atlas" />

==Aftermath==
The destruction of the Lorell Raiders forces provoked the women left behind on Hapes to take leadership of themselves into their own hands. Swearing that no man would ever rule them again, they invested their power into a [[First Queen Mother|single woman]] called the [[Queen Mother]], who then formed the female-dominated society of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]].<ref name="tnec" /> The defeat of the Lorell Raiders at the hands of the Jedi would also breed [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi sentiment]] among the Hapans for many generations.

After participating in many other battles, Jedi Master Arca Jeth died in [[3997 BBY]] on [[Deneba/Legends|Deneba]] after an attack by [[Krath war droid/Legends|Krath war droids]].<ref name="totj">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 3|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 3]]</ref>
